#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

struct HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching {
    int m, n;
    vector<vector<int>> g;
    vector<int> pairU, pairV, dis;
    const int inf = 10000000;
    const int NIL = 0;

    HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching(int m, int n, const vector<vector<int>>& g) : m(m), n(n), g(g) {
        pairU.assign(m + 1, NIL);
        pairV.assign(n + 1, NIL);
        dis.assign(m + 1, 0);
    }

    int maximumMatching() {
        fill(pairU.begin(), pairU.end(), NIL);
        fill(pairV.begin(), pairV.end(), NIL);
        int maxMatching = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
                if (pairU[i] == NIL && dfs(i)) {
                    ++maxMatching;
                }
            }
        }
        return maxMatching;
    }

    bool bfs() {
        queue<int> q;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            if (pairU[i] == NIL) {
                q.push(i);
                dis[i] = 0;
            } else {
                dis[i] = inf;
            }
        }
        dis[NIL] = inf;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            if (dis[u] < dis[NIL]) {
                for (int v : g[u]) {
                    if (dis[pairV[v]] == inf) {
                        q.push(pairV[v]);
                        dis[pairV[v]] = dis[u] + 2;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dis[NIL] < inf;
    }

    bool dfs(int u) {
        if (u != NIL) {
            for (int v : g[u]) {
                if (dis[pairV[v]] == dis[u] + 2) {
                    if (dfs(pairV[v])) {
                        pairV[v] = u;
                        pairU[u] = v;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
            dis[u] = inf;
            return false;
        } else {
            return true;
        }
    }
};

void addEdge(vector<vector<int>>& mat, vector<vector<int>>& g, int i, int j, int s, int t, int n, int m) {
    if (s <= 0 || t <= 0 || s > n || t > m) return;
    g[mat[i][j]].push_back(mat[s][t]);
}

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    long long ans = 0;

    if (n > 100) {
        int nn = (n - 100) % 6;
        long long nq = (n - 100) / 6;
        ans += nq * 6 * m;
        n = 100 + nn;
    }

    if (m > 100) {
        int nm = (m - 100) % 6;
        long long mq = (m - 100) / 6;
        ans += mq * 6 * n;
        m = 100 + nm;
    }

    vector<vector<int>> mat(n + 1, vector<int>(m + 1, 0));
    int u = 1, v = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                mat[i][j] = u++;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 != 0) {
                mat[i][j] = v++;
            }
        }
    }

    vector<vector<int>> g(u);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 3, j, n, m);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 2, j - 1, n, m);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 2, j + 1, n, m);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i, j - 3, n, m);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 1, j - 2, n, m);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 1, j - 2, n, m);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i, j + 3, n, m);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 1, j + 2, n, m);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 1, j + 2, n, m);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 3, j, n, m);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 2, j - 1, n, m);
                addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 2, j + 1, n, m);
            }
        }
    }

    HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching bpm(u - 1, v - 1, g);
    ans += 2 * bpm.maximumMatching();

    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;
}
